726 harpazo {har-pad'-zo}

源自 138 的衍生字; TDNT - 1:472,80; 動詞

欽定本 - catch up 4, take by force 3, catch away 2, pluck 2, catch 1, pull 1; 13

1) 奪取, 搶走
2) 突然取走
record.edic_text:
726 harpazo {har-pad'-zo}

from a derivative of 138; TDNT - 1:472,80; v

AV - catch up 4, take by force 3, catch away 2, pluck 2,
     catch 1, pull 1; 13

1) to seize, carry off by force
2) to seize on, claim for one's self eagerly
3) to snatch out or away

same.cexp: 搶劫；牢牢抓住；貪婪；奪走
該爭取的東西；該牢牢抓住的東西（#腓 2:6|）
奪走；抓走；帶走；提去（天上）
